_about: Editing mechanics measured from 10 public short-form videos by a top creator (796 s, 30 fps, 1080x1920). Every value here is mechanics only: pacing, layouts and timing. See rules.md: no other creator's branding is ever copied.
_labels: Each block says which values are measured (M), estimated (E) or house choices (H).

layouts.A: head only: full-frame talking head, caption low
layouts.B: head + title: two-line title in the top band at the start
layouts.C: head + top graphic: card, logo, photo or list in the top band, face untouched
layouts.D: full plate: light plate, one rounded graphic card, caption kept
layouts.E: plate + inset: speaker shrinks into a rounded card on a plate

planner._note: How the scripts turn the measured pacing into a plan.

zoom._label: M for ratios, E for the reading
zoom.recipe: jump cuts alternate between two fixed scales, 1.0 and 1.12, anchored on the face centre. No slow push-ins.

geometry._label: M unless noted. Fractions of the frame; pixels at 1080x1920.

captions.words_per_caption: 1, merge up to 2 when a word is shorter than 0.2 s
captions.position: centred; centre line at 0.771 of frame height; never moves between layouts
captions.case: as spoken (sentence case), bold sans, soft shadow
captions.on_plates: same row and size, softer contrast
captions.match_rule: caption text is the speaker's words exactly, taken from tight_words.json. Never reworded.

animation._label: M for frame counts; exits are H (not measured in the study)

plate_card.where: full screen plate, one rounded card centred
plate_card.trigger: a tool, chat, document or screen is named

product_card.trigger: a product or site is named

photo_insert.trigger: a person is named or a reaction beat

numbered_list.where: top-left, builds one line per spoken item

plate_inset.where: speaker in a rounded card on a plate, title above
plate_inset.trigger: a long walkthrough of one real thing

graphics.rule: A graphic is always a real thing tied to a spoken word, and gone within a few seconds. Where there is nothing real to show, show nothing.

audio._label: H: house target. Her files range -34 to -15 LUFS and are not a model.

brand._label: Placeholder. The real values come from brands/ (see scripts/common.py load_brand).
